input.descriptionHtml:
• Commercial electric rice cooker designed for restaurants, catering services, and food courts
  • 8-liter capacity cooks up to 45 servings, ideal for medium to high-volume operations
  • Powerful heating system ensures fast, even cooking with consistent results
  • Automatic cooking and keep-warm functions help maintain rice at serving temperature
  • Compact countertop design saves valuable kitchen space
  • Simple controls provide convenient daily operation
  • Durable construction supports continuous commercial use
  • Ideal for cooking rice for restaurants, cafeterias, hotels, and catering businesses

    • Technical Specifications

  • Model: VBSP-ERC64
  • Product Type: Commercial Electric Rice Cooker
  • Capacity: 8.0 Liters (45 Servings)
  • Voltage / Phase: 220–240V / 1 Phase
  • Power: 2650 W
  • Machine Dimensions: Ø450 x 250 mm
  • Net Weight: 10.2 kg

• Professional gas floor fryer designed for restaurants, cafés, and commercial kitchens
  • Full stainless steel construction provides excellent durability and easy cleaning
  • Electronic piezo ignition system with built-in safety device ensures reliable operation
  • Includes 6 frying baskets for high-volume cooking and efficient food preparation
  • Three high-performance burners deliver consistent heat distribution for fast frying
  • Floor-standing design with non-slip feet offers stability during operation
  • High gas output supports continuous cooking during busy service periods
  • Ideal for frying French fries, chicken, seafood, and a wide variety of fried foods

    • Technical Specifications

  • Model: GPB6BFS-17
  • Product Type: Gas Floor Fryer
  • Product Dimensions: 400 x 790 x 1010 mm
  • Packing Dimensions: 450 x 840 x 1000 mm
  • Gas Consumption: 52,000 BTU/hr
  • Packing Volume: 0.38 m³
  • Number of Burners: 3
  • Number of Fry Baskets: 6
  • Net Weight: 43 kg
